newsitem.title: INDIA: India's foreign curency assets at $21.16 bln-RBI.
newsitem.headline: India's foreign curency assets at $21.16 bln-RBI.

text.p: India's foreign currency reserves touched an all-time high of $21.16 billion on March 21, the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) said on Friday.
"This level is the highest ever held by the bank, surpassing the previous high of $20.81 billion as on March 31, 1995," the RBI said in a statement.
It said the present level in foreign currency assets would cover seven months of India's imports.
Foreign currency assets have increased by $4.12 billion during the current financial year (ending on March 31, 1997) so far, the statement added.
